name: pm51-wake-window
summary: PM51: port activity wakes the monitor as in stock, except during the first 5 s after standby entry (ignores the AUX burst caused by the entry itself); replaces pm51-wake-recheck

edits.asm: bank-0 free space: sat (0xA100), req (0xA10B), win (0xA114, window 5 s)
1 s task: inc 0x5E5E -> lcall sat (saturating at 255); nop nop nop
standby request (state 3, command 1): lcall 0x95CB -> lcall req (port mask, then 0x5E5E = 0)
event-2 check stub -> ljmp win (wake only after the window)

notes: Addresses are PM51 code addresses (bank 0, package offset 0x10080 + addr). Time base: XDATA 0x5E5E, +1 per second by the PM51 task 0x880F (also while asleep), otherwise unused; made saturating at 255. Window starts when the main firmware's standby request is processed (0x41A8). The stock port mask (fixed input: only that port wakes; automatic input: all ports) is unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_pm51_wake_window.py (WAKE_WINDOW=n, 2-60).
